# Step Right parser preparation fixtures

Every HTML file here is synthetic, written from the source playbook on
2026-09-13. These are contract examples, not archived source evidence.
The example people are invented. The invented `2.1` callback tests that
unverified sub-values remain uninterpreted; it does not establish that
the source prints this value.

Retained archive discovery evidence is
`research/verification/2026-09-11/cdx_steprightsolutions_html_all.json`.
The sibling `wayback_id_steprt_events_index.hdr` and
`wayback_id_steprt_round_507.hdr` / `508.hdr` files retain response
headers only. No corresponding response bodies are retained there.
These tests cannot answer promotion marking, alternate sub-values,
finals bib ownership, or coverage across real event years.
